senses.gloss: m. (כּוּת) Cuthean, a member of the sect of Samaritans. [In editions published under censorial influences our w. frequently takes the place of גוי, עכו״ם, מין &c., a. vice versa.] Ḥull. 3ᵇ.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:5">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 5</cite> (distinction between <he>כ׳</he> a. <cite ref="C00358"><he>גוי</he></cite>). Ib. 13ᵃ.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 3:1:4">Y. Keth. III, beg. 27ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כּוּתִים</he>, <he>כּוּתִיִּים</he>, <he>כּוּתִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 7:5:5">Y. Yeb. VII, 8ᵇ</cite> bot.
Ḥull. 3ᵇ Sot. 33ᵇ ספרי כ׳ the books of the Samaritans, v. זוּף I; Snh. 90ᵇ צדוקים ed. (Ms. M. כ׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); a. fr.—Fem. כּוּתִית.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:1">Keth. III, 1</cite>. Tosef. Oh. XVIII, 6; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כּוּתִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:2">Nidd. IV, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:2">Tosef. ib. V, 2</cite>; a. e.
